description: Verify that the login page title 'Login' is visible when the page loads
Verify that the username input field is present and has placeholder text 'Enter username'
Verify that the password input field is present and is of type password
Verify that the login button is visible and contains the text 'Login'
Verify that entering valid credentials (username: admin, password: password123) and clicking login shows a success message
Verify that entering invalid credentials shows an error message 'Invalid username or password'
Verify that submitting the login form with empty username and password shows error 'Please fill in all fields'
Verify that entering only username without password and clicking login shows the fill-all-fields error
Verify that the success message is hidden by default and only appears after successful login
Verify that after a failed login attempt, entering correct credentials and submitting again shows success and hides the error
Verify that the error message disappears when the user tries to login again after a failed attempt
Verify that the password field masks the input characters
Verify that the navigation bar contains three links: Login, Todo, and Search

issues: HALLUCINATED METHODS: page.getByTestId() returns a locator, not an element. Use locator.count() or locator.all() to get the number of elements.
WRONG ASSERTIONS: The test is checking if each link is visible, but it's not checking if the links have the correct text (Login, Todo, Search).
ASYNC ISSUES: The last expect() call is not awaited.
suggestions: Use page.getByTestId('nav-login').count() to get the number of elements with the data-testid 'nav-login'.
Use page.getByTestId('nav-login').textContent() to get the text content of the link and assert it's equal to 'Login'.
Add await to the last expect() call: await expect(links.length).toBe(3);

issues: HALLUCINATED METHODS: page.locator().all() is used correctly but locator.all() is the recommended method

suggestions: Use locator.all() instead of page.locator().all() for better readability
Verify that the length of the Set of testIds is equal to the length of the testIds array to ensure uniqueness

issues: HALLUCINATED METHODS: locator.first() is not a standard Playwright method, use locator.first() is not needed as locator will return the first element by default, but locator.nth() can be used for specific index
ASSERTION LOGIC: The test expects the search input to have a value of 'Test', but it should expect the value to be the same as the clicked search result item
suggestions: Replace the line with await page.getByTestId('search-result-item').click() with await page.getByTestId('search-result-item').nth(0).click() if you want to click the first result, or use a variable to store the text of the result item and then assert that the input has that value

Add a line to store the text of the search result item before clicking it, and then assert that the input has that value, for example: const resultItemText = await page.getByTestId('search-result-item').nth(0).textContent(); await expect(page.getByTestId('search-input')).toHaveValue(resultItemText)
